findings.summary: The award-card regression test only exercises top-talent (1 of 6 descriptionKeys) end-to-end in the browser; the other five are proven only by the unit-level dictionary-resolution test plus static code inspection, not by an actual EN-switch DOM assertion. Acceptable given the identical code path per card and the now-compile-time-checked key type, but worth a follow-up if award copy diverges per-card in a way that could break only some cards (e.g. a future overflow/line-clamp visual issue).
